literature_notes: PTK7 (Q13308) is a type I single-pass transmembrane receptor: extracellular 31–704, TM 705–720, intracellular 721–1070. The only ledger entry [L1] describes a 'PTK7-CFP' fusion used to validate cell-surface aptamer-mediated biotinylation. The naming convention 'PTK7-CFP' places CFP at the C-terminus, which falls entirely within the intracellular domain (residues 721–1070). The CFP serves as an expression reporter; the surface biotinylation is achieved by an aptamer binding the extracellular domain, not by the CFP tag. No ledger line reports any insertion — epitope tag, fluorescent protein, transposon, or domain insertion — on the extracellular face of PTK7. Zero sites qualify.

literature_other_positions.note: PTK7-CFP C-terminal fusion places CFP in the intracellular compartment (residues 721–1070 are cytoplasmic); used as an expression reporter for aptamer-mediated surface biotinylation, not as an extracellular tag.
